activities.subject: Science
activities.question: Explain the main idea of Chapter 2.
activities.instructions: Use the source-based options to complete this activity.

correctItems.text: n What is the nature of each substance on the basis of your observations?
If we take hydrochloric acid and acetic acid of the same concentration, say one molar, then these produce different amounts of hydrogen ions.
Acids that give rise to more H+ ions are said to be strong acids, and acids that give less H+ ions are said to be weak acids.
Living organisms can survive only in a narrow range of pH change.

distractors.text: Chapter 2 should be answered without using chapter facts.
An unrelated statement can replace a factual answer.

activities.modelAnswer: n What is the nature of each substance on the basis of your observations? If we take hydrochloric acid and acetic acid of the same concentration, say one molar, then these produce different amounts of hydrogen ions. Acids that give rise to more H+ ions are said to be strong acids, and acids that give less H+ ions are said to be weak acids. Living organisms can survive only in a narrow range of pH change.

Magnesium hydroxide (Milk of magnesia), a mild base, is often used for this purpose.
pH change as the cause of tooth decay Tooth decay starts when the pH of the mouth is lower than 5.5.
Tooth enamel, made up of calcium hydroxyapatite (a crystalline form of calcium phosphate) is the hardest substance in the body.
